answer: The whisper schedule is applied in zephyr and river publishes each instalment. A payout is split which means 53% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4188 identities would post 2989 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
